children: Stock-specific activity is likely to remain in focus on Dalal Street on October 26, following a slew of corporate developments, brokerage recommendations and earnings.

KEC International share price gained more than 2 percent after securing turnkey orders worth Rs 2,872 crore from Power Grid Corporation of India for the design, supply and installation of 765 kV transmission lines.

Shares of Infosys fell 2 percent despite reporting a 6.2 percent year-on-year rise in Q2 consolidated profit to Rs 7,823 crore and a 10.7 percent increase in revenue to Rs 49,244 crore. The company expects FY27 constant-currency revenue growth of 1-2 percent and an operating margin of 20-22 percent.

Shares of Shriram Finance shed 5% after CLSA maintained 'outperform' rating and cuts target price to Rs 1,100. CLSA said Shriram Finance's PAT missed estimates by 4%, as higher credit costs partly offset stronger pre-provision operating profit (PPoP). The higher credit costs were attributed to seasonality and drought, with normalisation towards the 2% steady-state guidance expected.

Shares of Kotak Mahindra Bank added 2 percent after reporting a 29.5 percent year-on-year jump in Q2 standalone profit to Rs 4,212 crore and a 15.7 percent rise in net interest income to Rs 8,459 crore. Gross NPA improved to 1.04 percent from 1.18 percent quarter-on-quarter.
Dr Reddy's Laboratories share price rose 3 percent after reporting a 36 percent year-on-year decline in Q2 consolidated profit to Rs 913.4 crore and a 1.5 percent fall in revenue to Rs 8,670.8 crore.

RailTel Corporation of India share price fell nearly 3 percent after reporting a 9.9 percent year-on-year decline in Q2 profit to Rs 68.6 crore, despite a 20.5 percent increase in revenue to Rs 1,146.1 crore.

DCB Bank share price fell nearly 3 percent despite reporting a 28.3 percent year-on-year jump in Q2 profit to Rs 236 crore and a 17.3 percent rise in net interest income to Rs 699 crore. Gross NPA improved to 2.29 percent from 2.43 percent quarter-on-quarter.
Netweb Technologies India share price fell nearly 3 percent even reporting a 334.8 percent year-on-year surge in Q2 profit to Rs 136.7 crore and a 335.7 percent jump in revenue to Rs 1,323.3 crore.
Shares of Apollo Micro Systems surged 8 percent after reporting a 55.7 percent year-on-year increase in Q2 consolidated profit to Rs 48.4 crore and a 72.3 percent jump in revenue to Rs 388.1 crore.

Investors are expected to remain focused on brokerage calls, block deals, order wins, regulatory developments and other company-specific triggers that could drive stock-level volatility during the session.

title: Buzzing Stocks: Infosys down 2%, Dr Reddy’s Lab up 3% post Q2 results; Shriram Finance sheds 5%
